title: Docusaurus AudioLab sample-load demo capture
description: Launch the AudioLab playground on its configured iOS simulator, apply the reversible issue #414 debug-banner fixture, prove the banner is absent before Load Sample, press load-sample-button, prove the exact banner appears, and emit docs-ready proof artifacts.

proofTargets.claim: Farmslot can launch and control the real AudioLab playground app through its configured simulator and Metro port.
The app interaction is driven through the real Import screen and load-sample-button, then validated with visible screenshot/video evidence.

prepare-demo-fixture.description: Apply and later restore the local AudioLab issue #414 debug-banner fixture.

launch-audiolab.description: Launch AudioLab playground with WATCHER_PORT and IOS_SIMULATOR read from project config/.env.

assert-banner-absent.description: Open the Import screen and verify the demo banner is absent before sample audio loads.

record-sample-load.description: Record the iOS simulator while the recipe presses load-sample-button and waits for the banner.

assert-banner-present.description: Verify the exact demo banner text is present after sample audio loads and capture final screenshot proof.
